decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core pipeline-components business in a growing market, it is inexpensive to keep available and there is still too little evidence after launch to justify abandoning the option.

This bracket product fits the firm's established fabrication capabilities and customer base, so management would likely keep it on offer while demand uncertainty resolves at relatively low holding cost.
Because the product builds directly on existing know-how and broadens the range for infrastructure customers, the firm is likely to retain it as a low-cost option rather than drop it quickly.
